T: We're on a mission from food.
D: Two brothers reunite their blues band to save their childhood orphanage.
P: Serve the mains when they walk into the Soul Food Cafe.
S: Fried onion cornmeal fritters with hot sauce butter for dipping
Cornmeal and flour with buttermilk, egg, grated onion and a pinch of sugar, spooned into 175C oil and fried until golden. Hot sauce butter to dip.
Peanuts roasted in the shell with salt and cayenne
Peanuts in the shell roasted at 180C for 20 minutes, tossed hot with salt and cayenne, served in a tin bucket.
M: Buttermilk brined chicken pieces, double dredged and fried crisp
Chicken pieces brined overnight in buttermilk and hot sauce, double-dredged in seasoned flour, fried at 165C until 74C inside. Pile them high, all four.
Soul Food Cafe smothered chops and greens
Aretha's diner, where Elwood just wants dry white toast

Thick pork chops browned and simmered in onion gravy, with smoky ham hock collard greens and buttered white toast to mop the plate. Simmer 1 smoked ham hock in 1.5L water with 1 onion for 60 minutes. Add 2 bunches shredded silverbeet or kale, 1 tbsp cider vinegar and chilli flakes and cook 20 minutes. Season 4 thick pork chops, dust in flour and brown in oil 3 minutes a side, then remove. Cook 2 sliced onions in the pan 8 minutes, stir in 2 tbsp flour, then 500ml chicken stock. Return the chops, cover and simmer 30 minutes. Serve with the greens and buttered toast.
W: Buttery rice flour shortbread baked pale and cut into fingers
Plain Scottish shortbread cut into dead-straight fingers, pricked in neat rows and dusted with sugar.
K: Soul Food Cafe peach sweet tea
Sweet black tea blended with peach, served over ice with lemon and mint

Strong black tea brewed with sugar and ripe peaches, chilled hard and poured over ice with lemon and mint, a proper Southern diner jug. Steep 6 black tea bags in 1L boiling water for 5 minutes, remove and stir in 120g caster sugar. Blend 2 ripe peaches (or 400g tinned peaches, drained) with 250ml cold water and strain into the tea. Add 500ml cold water and chill for at least 2 hours. Pour over glasses of ice with lemon slices and a sprig of mint.

s.note: Fried onion cornmeal fritters with hot sauce butter for dipping
s.how: Mix 150g cornmeal, 75g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp sugar, 1 grated onion, 1 egg and 200ml buttermilk. Drop spoonfuls into 175C oil and fry until golden. Melt 60g butter with 2 tbsp hot sauce for dipping.

s.note: Peanuts roasted in the shell with salt and cayenne
s.how: Spread 400g peanuts in the shell on a tray and roast at 180C for 20 minutes. Toss straight away with fine salt and a pinch of cayenne. Tip into a tin bucket, behind chicken wire if you can manage it.

m.note: Buttermilk brined chicken pieces, double dredged and fried crisp
m.how: Brine 1.5kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with 2 tbsp hot sauce. Dredge twice in 300g flour seasoned with salt and 2 tsp smoked paprika. Fry at 165C until 74C inside, about 14 minutes. Pile them high on a platter.

w.note: Buttery rice flour shortbread baked pale and cut into fingers
w.how: Beat 250g soft butter with 110g caster sugar, then work in 300g plain flour and 60g rice flour. Press into a lined 20 by 30cm tin, prick in neat rows and chill 20 minutes. Bake at 150C for 45 minutes until pale gold, sprinkle with sugar and cut into fingers while warm.

Blend 2 ripe peaches (or 400g tinned peaches, drained) with 250ml cold water and strain into the tea. Add 500ml cold water and chill for at least 2 hours. Pour over glasses of ice with lemon slices and a sprig of mint.
